pool.text: The Qing dynasty took Ürümqi during its military conquest of the Dzungar Khanate.
A city named Gongning Cheng was built nearby to the northwest to house Manchu bannermen.
The Battle of Ürümqi took place between the Turkic Muslim forces and Dungan Muslim forces.
The Guangxu Emperor established Xinjiang as a province, with Dihua as its capital.
Ürümqi became the de facto political and economic capital of Xinjiang following protests.
Bombings in Ürümqi followed the Ghulja incident resulting in 20 deaths and injuries.
The completion of the new office tower for Ürümqi Municipal Government marked a shift north.
The city commenced the construction of viaducts for Outer Ring Road lacking a subway.
Zhongshan Road has been one of the ten most famous commercial streets in China.
Blacksmith Institute mentioned Ürümqi in World's Worst Polluted Places caused by air pollution.
Maison Mode Ürümqi opened as a notable department store for luxury merchandise.
Toronto Star listed Ürümqi as one of the top ten worst places to live due to pollution.
Riots occurred between ethnic Han Chinese and Uyghurs in the largest ethnic violence.
A new industrial area called Ganquanbao Industrial Park was developed west of the reservoir.
The Ürümqi Bus Rapid Transit bus service was launched after an investment of yuan.
The Ürümqi Metro opened when the northern section of Line 1 was opened.
The southern section of Line 1 opened to the public in the city.
The city's GDP reached CN¥465.8 billion with a specific GDP per capita.
